accepted_behavior: Freeze checks all nine evaluation source records and all controller records against passed reviews, retains exact review bytes, preserves the historical forty-two-source closure and five calibration files, and runs the original contract in the actual packaged layout before creating the freeze receipt.

The preservation wrapper retains actual native/adapter tokens, initial states, all34 cell tensors and logits plus both complete FP32 native/optimized matrix banks while preserving original comparison behavior.

The external semantic gate checks shapes, dtypes, finiteness, lane coupling and raw-bit equality, and binds the fixed original engineering recipe and source identities before a development acknowledgement can authorize fitting.

The exact development acknowledgement is bound to the externally accepted manifest. N100 begins only with finite measured timing and enough remaining work time for100 *1.25 *max(measured,130.48383641405962) +900 seconds.

The worker executes the original fullN100 fitter, immediately preserves the sealed checkpoint and bank, then executes the unchanged old two-seed148-item evaluator. Partial checkpoints remain explicitly incomplete and cannot pass final science validation.

The receiver reconstructs the original sealed generation, validates the original owner and all100 initialization records, and independently computes NumPy FP32 division and FP16 conversion for every matrix entry, comparing integer bits and retaining deterministic numeric samples.

The receiver invokes the pinned original seventeen-file readout validator under a private namespace and requires the exact new fitted generation identity. Historical bank agreement is reported without requiring a checksum match for acceptance.

Failure handling retains closed child logs and completed declared artifacts after process-group quiescence, preserves an actual sealed partial cursor, and records recovery failures without replacing the original failure.
